connections.why: Both focus on British history, with the thematic study tracing long-term change and the depth study examining one period and place in detail
Both build secure chronological knowledge of causation and consequence across a defined era
Period and world depth studies frequently share modern themes of conflict, ideology and international change
Long-term British change provides context for the wider period studied
Themes such as power, migration or warfare connect British change to wider world history
Both develop the close source-analysis skills at the heart of SHP depth study
